title: 02 — WORK BREAKDOWN STRUCTURE
summary: Work breakdown of 46 implementation tasks (T-001…T-806) with objectives, inputs, outputs, dependencies, validation commands and acceptance criteria.
notes: No frontmatter. Not an ADR (no Decision/Consequences, no status) and not a PRD (no user stories). Content is implementation-level contracts: exact file outputs, tool configs, validation commands, objective acceptance criteria per task -> classified SPEC. Ambiguity: could be read as an execution-plan DOC since it is task sequencing rather than a system contract; SPEC chosen per higher-precedence-signal rule.
